title: Detailed robot vacuum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- floor shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='40' ry='9' fill='#1b2a4a'/>
  <!-- main body base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='38' ry='20' fill='#2d6fc2'/>
  <!-- top plate -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='34' ry='16' fill='#3f8ae0'/>
  <!-- bumper ring -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='39' ry='20' fill='none' stroke='#7dc4ff' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- top sensor tower -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='14' ry='7' fill='#57a8ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#8fd0ff'/>
  <!-- lidar window -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='5' ry='2.5' fill='#d9f4ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='1.6' fill='#24578f'/>
  <!-- status light -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='3' fill='#a6ffcb'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='1.2' fill='#eafff2'/>
  <!-- side buttons -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='66' r='2.5' fill='#bfe6ff'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='66' r='2.5' fill='#bfe6ff'/>
  <!-- dust bin lid line -->
  <path d='M30 68 Q50 76 70 68' fill='none' stroke='#8bc3f2' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='28' ry='8' fill='#24558f'/>
  <!-- side brush left -->
  <g fill='#ffd76a'>
    <ellipse cx='23' cy='74' rx='7' ry='2'/>
    <ellipse cx='21' cy='71' rx='2' ry='5'/>
    <ellipse cx='21' cy='77' rx='2' ry='5'/>
  </g>
  <circle cx='23' cy='74' r='2.5' fill='#ffb938'/>
  <!-- side brush right -->
  <g fill='#ffd76a'>
    <ellipse cx='77' cy='74' rx='7' ry='2'/>
    <ellipse cx='79' cy='71' rx='2' ry='5'/>
    <ellipse cx='79' cy='77' rx='2' ry='5'/>
  </g>
  <circle cx='77' cy='74' r='2.5' fill='#ffb938'/>
  <!-- main brush roller visible -->
  <rect x='36' y='74' width='28' height='4' rx='2' fill='#f5a623'/>
  <line x1='40' y1='74' x2='40' y2='78' stroke='#ffd76a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='45' y1='74' x2='45' y2='78' stroke='#ffd76a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='74' x2='50' y2='78' stroke='#ffd76a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='74' x2='55' y2='78' stroke='#ffd76a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='74' x2='60' y2='78' stroke='#ffd76a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='81' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#2f3f57'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='80' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#556b89'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='81' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#2f3f57'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='80' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#556b89'/>
  <!-- front caster wheel -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='83' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#6f8fb3'/>
